name: Tick Auto-Correct (240 TPS)
description: Automatically corrects clicks that are 1-16 ticks early or late by simulating 480 ticks ahead at 240 TPS.

enabled.name: Enable Tick Auto-Correct
enabled.description: Automatically places early or late clicks onto a passing tick verified for the next 480 ticks at 240 TPS.

max-ticks.name: Auto-Correct Window (1-16 Ticks)
max-ticks.description: Maximum number of ticks (from 1 to 16 ticks at 240 TPS) to search backward (late) or forward (early) for a passing click tick.

correct-early.name: Correct Early Clicks (+1 to +16 Ticks)
correct-early.description: If a click is 1-16 ticks too early and would fail the 480-tick check, delay it to the nearest passing tick.

correct-late.name: Correct Late Clicks (-1 to -16 Ticks)
correct-late.description: If a click is 1-16 ticks too late, rewind to the passing tick in the 16-tick ring buffer and replay back to current tick.

death-rescue.name: Auto-Rescue Late Clicks on Death
death-rescue.description: When about to die to a click check, check if clicking 1-16 ticks earlier passes the next 480 ticks and auto-correct.

lookahead-ticks.name: Survival Check Horizon (Ticks @ 240 TPS)
lookahead-ticks.description: Number of ticks at 240 TPS to verify survival after a corrected click (480 ticks = 2.00 seconds).

show-hud.name: Show In-Game HUD & Correction Status
show-hud.description: Displays the active tick window (1-16t) and live correction feedback on the gameplay screen.
